title: Goal file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter required on every .context/goals/*.md file. A superset of context-frontmatter: every field there applies, plus goal-status.

title.description: Human-readable title matching the H1 heading.

type.description: Always 'goal'. Singular form of the goals/ typology.

date.description: Creation date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), set once by scripts/goal.sh. Do not update on subsequent edits.

status.description: Index-facing lifecycle, shared with every other context file so context-index and the SessionStart hook read goals without special-casing. 'active' covers goal-status new and in-progress; 'done' covers completed and promoted.

goal-status.description: Goal lifecycle. 'new' on creation; 'in-progress' the first time any item gains evidence; 'completed' when no todo or awaiting items remain; 'promoted' when a trigger moved the work to a plan. A promoted goal is not a completed one and the two must never be conflated.

tags.description: Free-form tags. Always emitted, as an empty array when none were given.

related.description: Relative paths to related .context files. On promotion this carries the new plan's path. Omit the field entirely when empty; never emit related: [].

blocks.description: Relative paths to context files that cannot be considered ready until this goal reaches status: done. Omit when empty.

blocked-by.description: Relative paths to context files that must reach status: done before this goal is ready. Read by context-index's scripts/context-ready.sh. Omit when empty.
